page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.l: jam usitata tempestive singulis semestribus
locent, quanti omnino queant, & a conducto-
ribus publicanis sponsiones idoneas dari cu-
rent, per quas Respub. indemnis esse possit, nec
permittant, ut Quaestor aut quisquam alius
munus a provincia acceptum gerens, aut pecu-
niam provinciae tractans, vectigalia tributa-
que huiusmodi conducat, aut in societate cum
conductorum quoquam sit, aut etiam sponso-
rem se praestet: denique ut in eo sint, ne quid
in fraudem provinciae tota hac in re a quo-
quam committatur, non a publicanis, non a
provincialibus; ne publicanis fraus ulla fiat,
ve ipsi praeter legem provinciales affligant, ut
lites inter eos orta, quam citissime expedian-
tur: ut potestatem habeant cum(Comite guber-
natore militares praefecturas superiores & in-
feriores vacantes conferendi, modo ii, quibus
conferuntur, non displiceant provinciae Ordi-
nibus, quod cognoscendum proxime futuris
comitiis: a reliquis vero curationibus aut
muneribus quaestorum, secretariorum, arma-
mentarii magistrorum, similiumque tribuen-
dis abstineant, eamque curam comitiis relin-
quant: cum militares praefecturas conferent,
intraneos, modo idonei sint, extraneis pra-
eferant

page.notes: Line-end hyphens kept: "præ-" / "ferant" (catchword). Catchword "ferant" stands at right below the last line and is not repeated in the text. Long s set as plain s throughout. The printed "ue" before "ipsi" is read as "ve" (for neve). The printed "ij" after "modo" is read as "ii". The bracket before "Comite" is printed as "(" directly after "cum" and is kept as printed. Page number printed in an old form ("¾90") and read as 290. Faint stain at the lower left and watermark at the lower right are excluded.
